{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "ipc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes to src/interfaces/wallet.h merely expose wallet functionality to GUI/node interfaces rather than modifying IPC machinery or process separation infrastructure.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Interface method additions serving wallet features are wallet-first and not ipc unless the interface mechanics themselves are the point."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Adds the new node-level diagnostic RPC `scantxforsilentpayments` in src/rpc/output_script.cpp and updates src/rpc/rawtransaction_util.cpp to handle silent payment destinations.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Introduces a new diagnostic RPC method `scantxforsilentpayments` to inspect transactions for silent payments outputs alongside raw transaction output script utilities."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Functional and unit tests added (test/functional/wallet_silentpayments_sending.py, rpc_scantxforsilentpayments.py, coinselector_tests.cpp) test wallet and RPC functionality, not testing framework infrastructure.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Tests pinning the behavior of silent payment sending belong to wallet and rpc rather than test infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes in src/common/paymentdestination.* and src/common/bip352.* implement domain-specific payment abstractions and Silent Payment logic rather than general shared node utilities.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Shared code supporting a specific area's domain behavior belongs to that area rather than general utilities."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Touches wallet transaction creation, coin selection, fee bumping, wallet database persistence, and wallet RPCs across src/wallet/spend.cpp, feebumper.cpp, and walletdb.cpp.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.68,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Adds wallet sending support for BIP 352 Silent Payments, resolving the inability of Bitcoin Core users to transact with recipients relying on Silent Payments for address reuse prevention and privacy without external wallets."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 1,
    "bug_severity": 0,
    "performance": 0,
    "user_value": 3,
    "leverage": 2
  }
}
